roles.title: Full-stack Developer
roles.description:
Worked on a live music marketplace website connecting artists and venues while simplifying the process of booking a live music event.

I was the only developer of the application, responsible for all front-end and back-end development. We used Angular (with TailwindCSS and RxJS) for front-end, Firebase Cloud Functions and Node.js for back-end to implement API endpoints for data handling transactions, and Firebase Storage and Firestore for database. Designs were communicated via Figma.

We have successfully extended our user base from only local bars and restaurants in Queensland to other venues across Australia, some of which are in Sydney and Melbourne.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description:
Worked on an Electron application that provides an intuitive and extensible environment to work with data components and flows.

I was the owner of the visualisation project for the AI team to demonstrate their models. My job was to create a component-based data flow application that allows running multiple data components and connecting them into a flow of inputs and outputs. The requirement was to create a desktop application, and to utilise the web technologies, I decided to use Electron and designed it to be a web application. I used JavaScript (with jQuery) as the main library to work with front-end development, and used JavaScript/TypeScript to write the back-end code that runs on Node.js.

The application has been used in several AI model demonstrations for the company.
